item.title: Is There an Oscar Bump? ‘The Perfect Neighbor’ Saw Views Triple on Netflix After Its Nomination
item.description: Exclusive: Geeta Gandbhir's documentary surpassed 50 million views on the streamer since its debut back in October.

item.title: ‘The Travel Companion’ Trailer: What’s Harder Than Indie Filmmaking? Healthy Male Friendship
item.description: Exclusive: Travis Wood and Alex Mallis' feature debut follows a striving filmmaker whose big friendship perk is thrown into disarray by the arrival of (gasp) a more successful creator.

item.title: ‘Silent Friend’ Trailer: Tony Leung Befriends a Ginkgo Tree in Ildikó Enyedi’s Sensitive and Mysterious Venice Breakout
item.description: Exclusive: Enyedi's "On Body and Soul" follow-up will launch a retrospective on Leung's career at Film at Lincoln Center.

item.title: ‘The Stranger’ Trailer: François Ozon Does Albert Camus in Summery, Black-and-White Style
item.description: Exclusive: "Summer of 85" breakout Benjamin Voisin plays Meursault, the walking existential black hole whose crime is not only murder but indifference once he kills an Algerian man.

item.title: Beyond Fest Announces Programming for Inaugural Chicago Edition in April
item.description: The beloved Los Angeles genre festival heads to the Windy City's Music Box Theatre next month.

item.title: ‘The Hunger’ by Way of Bertolucci: Costume Designer Sarah Evelyn on ‘The Beauty’
item.description: The costume designer talks about making a show that's both sci-fi and contemporary, and how series creator Ryan Murphy encouraged her to go "as far as humanly possible" with her concepts.

item.title: ‘The Bride!’ Review: Maggie Gyllenhaal Graverobs Mary Shelley for a Wokified, ‘Joker’-fied Folie-à-Deux Zonked on Its Own Rage
item.description: Jessie Buckley's anguished scream of a performance can't sustain an ambitious feminist opera that feels unintentionally, conspicuously tailor-made to align with Warner Bros.' neighboring DC properties.

item.title: Watch How the ‘Sinners’ VFX Team Makes the Dead Look Alive
item.description: Exclusive: Watch some of the VFX process that allowed Ryan Coogler's ideas about real-time twins and an IMAX oner for the ages to come to life.

item.title: Everyone Seems in Favor of a ‘Sinners’ Star Winning an Oscar. Which Actor(s) Will It Be?
item.description: Momentum has built for the "Sinners" cast after the BAFTA and Actor Awards. Has it been enough for Michael B. Jordan, Wunmi Mosaku, and/or Delroy Lindo to win the Oscar?

item.title: ‘Young Sherlock’ Stars Hero Fiennes Tiffin and Joseph Fiennes Crack the Case on Big Spoilers and Real Chemistry
item.description: The actors — and real-life family — play father and son in a zippy new spin on the earliest years of the world's most famous detective. Ahead, the duo tell IndieWire about their on- and off-screen bond and giddily unpack a first season's worth of spoilers.
